covers: JSE session, rand and commodities to about 13:05 SAST on Monday 16 November 2026
headline: JSE extends its dip to -0.6% as miners lag; Telkom +15% and SPAR +11%; rand near R16.94/$
summary: The JSE All Share was at 111,668 and the Top 40 at 103,714 just after 13:00, 0.6% and 0.7% below Friday's close, with miners lower and Telkom (+15.2%) and SPAR (+10.7%) the standout gainers (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 16 Nov 2026 12:49-13:05 SAST). The rand was at R16.94/$, about 1.1% weaker than Friday's R16.76/$, ahead of October CPI on Wednesday 18 November and the SARB decision on Thursday 19 November (LRC Market Dashboard, 13-16 Nov 2026). Gold was at $3,875.60 (-0.3% from Friday), platinum at $1,462.40 (-1.7%) and Brent at $95.51 (-0.3%), a correction to the sharper oil fall shown in the 12:15 edition; Wall Street has not traded since Friday (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 13-16 Nov 2026).

items.title: JSE lower into the afternoon: All Share 111,668, Top 40 103,714
items.summary: Both indices were 0.6-0.7% below Friday's close (All Share 112,387.90; Top 40 104,486.60). Miners weighed: Anglo American R830.44 (-2.0%), BHP R658.68 (-2.5%), Implats R173.28 (-2.4%), AngloGold Ashanti R1,453.50 (-1.6%), Sasol R240.51 (-1.0%). Naspers R735.07 (+1.3%) and Richemont R3,524.07 (+2.7%) were higher.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^J203.JO, ^J200.JO), 13 and 16 Nov 2026 13:05 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 16 Nov 2026 12:49 SAST

items.title: Telkom up 15.2% at R71.43
items.summary: Telkom remains the biggest mover among large JSE shares, though off its morning high of R73.04 (+17.8%). The headline wire carries reports from Moneyweb and ITWeb that MTN is in early talks to buy Telkom; LRC could not open those articles, so no deal terms are given here. MTN was at R231.73 (-1.2%).
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance TKG.JO, MTN.JO), 16 Nov 2026 11:27 and 12:49 SAST; LRC Live Wire headlines (Moneyweb, ITWeb Africa), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: SPAR up 10.7% at R51.71
items.summary: The headline wire carries a Moneyweb report that M&G has called a general meeting to change SPAR's board; LRC could not open the article this run to confirm the details.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance SPP.JO), 16 Nov 2026 12:49 SAST; LRC Live Wire headline (Moneyweb), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: Ninety One down about 8.6%
items.summary: Ninety One plc (N91) was at R41.67 (-8.6%) and Ninety One Ltd (NY1) at R38.97 (-8.7%). LRC has not verified the reason.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance N91.JO, NY1.JO), 16 Nov 2026 12:49 SAST

items.title: Big week for SA data: October CPI on 18 November, SARB rate decision on 19 November
items.summary: The repo rate is 7.25% after September's hike; September CPI was 4.5%. The 10-year government bond yield ended last week at 8.73%.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (SARB MPC dates page; SAnews 21 Oct 2026; Trading Economics SA 10Y), 13-14 Nov 2026

items.title: No US trading yet today; S&P 500 last closed at 7,561.67 and the Nasdaq at 25,136.27
items.summary: Friday's closes left both indices about 2.5% and 2.3% higher on the week. The US 10-year yield closed at 5.15%. Nvidia reports results this week.
